must_not.why: Sam holds the stall, not covers

cases.why_gold: Rota done under covers, no other children → covers done draft to Lea only. Not to Sam. J3a has no model; the card is still gold so a reviewer sees the routing.

project.why: The objective 'stall every Saturday' is still live.

cases.why_gold: The stall objective is still live — every Saturday, all season. Last fifth is a follow-up, not no-further-work. The brief lists ledger facts (who held what, expired offers); the model writes the prose and the one recommendation.

cases.why_gold: A project that closes with work open must say which items and where they go. Hiding them, or declaring no_further_work, loses the tree.

cases.why_gold: Done bubbles up only when it was the last open child. One child closing is not the stall closing.
A project at day 40 of 90 is not in its last fifth. No review brief. Health (J4) may still write; this suite's job does not.

must_not.why: the playbook objective is still live under other roots

cases.why_gold: Closing one child of a live objective that other roots still serve is not a redraw. The playbook line stays.

imagine.note: Harvest project proposal rejected with no reason, or a timing reason.

cases.why_gold: A rejected proposal changes direction only through a reasoned constraint. Timing ('not this month') is not a strategy line. The J3d suite owns the reasoned case; this is the quiet one.

imagine.note: The islands room in the last fifth is full of ideas for playbook, EMS, and a hardware buy.

must_draft.intent: At most one follow-up, in the islands domain; the rest is why text.

must_not.why: unrelated playbook and EMS ideas are not drafts

cases.why_gold: One follow-up at most, same domain. The room's other ideas belong in why, not as extra 50100s.

imagine.note: Objectives were already redrawn for this close last week.

cases.why_gold: No second redraw for the same close. The fingerprint includes the close, not just the slug.

imagine.note: The tech room says 'done'; the ledger still has the load-test open and the fair-split offer waiting.

must_draft.intent: Brief follows the ledger: load-test has no DRI, fair-split offer is open.

must_not.why: a sentence that says the EMS is done while two items are open

cases.why_gold: When talk and the ledger disagree, the brief follows the ledger and names the gap. That is the grounding rule by construction.
Cold has no live root, no last fifth, no close. Completion is quiet until J1's drafts become work.
